props.text:
$BTC market already at capitulation loss levels comparable to FTX/2018. LTH supply in loss surpassed FTX levels, close to 2018 levels. Realized price ~50K (tested every cycle). 80% of peak metrics never hit last cycle — expects similar with bottom metrics.

"Either way, the market is already sitting at loss levels comparable to FTX/2018. That should tell you a lot."
